title: ENHANCING SELECTION OF CLIMATE TECH STARTUPS WITH AI: A CASE STUDY ON INTEGRATING HUMAN AND AI EVALUATIONS IN THE CLIMATECH GREAT GLOBAL INNOVATION CHALLENGE

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing AI-generated evaluation scores and Z-score rankings of climate tech startups with those of human judges using Spearman's correlation to identify discrepancies and mitigate subjective human judgments in deal screening.
Collecting participant ratings and qualitative feedback to evaluate the perceived fairness, impartiality, and transparency of the AI judge during live pitch evaluations and Q&A sessions.
